value.rationale: The paper describes the equilibria as a finite principal pair and studies restricted plotting windows, whereas the complete unbounded family has a diverging, order-dependent number of linearly asymptotically stable equilibria near the threshold. This changes a natural invariant of the published model; the asymptotic coefficient is not a routine arbitrary finite statistic.
